drifted.spec_text: Server MUST shut down the dispatcher when receiving SIGTERM/SIGINT, draining active requests and completing all in-flight operations before exiting
drifted.actual: Only SIGINT handled via tokio::signal::ctrl_c(); SIGTERM not caught, so 'kill <pid>' does not trigger graceful shutdown

drifted.spec_text: IPC handle contains a memory address (or opaque identifier) and a size field, address transmitted as a 64-bit integer (pointer value)
drifted.actual: IPC handle uses a 64-byte CUDA IPC memory handle (bytes field) plus uint32 size, which is superior for cross-process GPU sharing but diverges from spec assumption
